summary.text: Chris Poulos has represented Connecticut's 81st House District since 2023 and is the Democratic candidate for the seat on the November 3, 2026 ballot.

paragraphs.text: He was born in and lives in Southington, and graduated from Southington High School in 1993.
He earned a B.A. from the University of Richmond in 1997 and a master's degree in the teaching of Spanish from Columbia University in 2003.
He worked as a teacher at Joel Barlow High School in Redding and as a teacher-leader in residence with the Connecticut State Department of Education.
